title: Represent and Describe Data in a Box Plot
objective: I can make and read a box plot to summarize a data set.
model: box plot drawn from the five-number summary of an ordered list (median, Q1 and Q3 as medians of the halves, whiskers to minimum and maximum)

widgets.component: Median warm-up: ordered, unordered, even count, why order first
widgets.root: Matches the lesson's warm-up; keys 9, 6, 7 verified.

widgets.component: IQR from a five-number summary, median line, middle 50%, added-quartiles IQR mistake
widgets.root: IQR = Q3 − Q1 is stated in the lesson's own key idea; keys 13, median, 50% verified; the err fix (30 − 18 = 12) is right.
Range (maximum − minimum) is the subject of lesson 2-5 and appears nowhere in 2-4's objective, key idea or worked example.
widgets.replacement: Replace with 'Find the minimum and maximum of 14, 22, 8, 31, 17 (the ends of the whiskers)' with keys 8 and 31.

widgets.component: Five-number summary of 9 values, term match, IQR comparison, Q1 mistake
widgets.root: Rechecked the table (Q1 10, median 18, Q3 27.5, IQR 17.5) and the Eagles err (Q1 = (8 + 10) ÷ 2 = 9). The quartile-as-median-of-a-half rule matches the worked example.

widgets.component: Read min / Q1 / median / Q3 / max; count values between quartiles of a stated n
widgets.root: Figures are the shared `box` viz with a labelled scale; L3 'each quarter holds n ÷ 4' answers verified (44 gives 22, 52 gives 13, 28 gives 14).

widgets.component: Box plot: range, IQR, or percent at / below a quartile
widgets.root: About a third of L2 draws ask 'What is the range?' (sampled 120 seeds): range is a 2-5 skill.
widgets.replacement: Remove the range variant: replace 'What is the range?' with 'What is the third quartile (Q3)?' or 'What is the length of the box?' and, for the L4 comparison statements, keep only median and IQR/box-length claims (drop 'greater range ... because its whisker reaches farther').

widgets.component: Build the chart: sort the values, mark the five numbers, the box draws itself, then answer what fraction is inside the box
widgets.root: Genuine construction: sort by tapping smallest-first, set min / Q1 / median / Q3 / max, and the SVG redraws. Quartiles use the lesson's rule (middle value left out of both halves for an odd n); feedback names the middle-value and range-vs-IQR slips.

widgets.component: 'What is Team A's IQR?', 'What is Team B's IQR?', 'Is the fan right that Team B is better because of the 80-point game?'
widgets.root: No figure and no data: Team A, Team B and the fan's claim come from the lesson's Connect scenario (Team A 40, 52, 60, 68, 75; Team B 35, 55, 61, 65, 80) and were dropped.
widgets.replacement: Attach one `box` figure with both teams on one scale: viz box {plots:[{label:'Team A',min:40,q1:52,med:60,q3:68,max:75},{label:'Team B',min:35,q1:55,med:61,q3:65,max:80}], scale 30–85, label 'Points per game'}, and put the fan's claim in 5.3's stem. Keep keys 16, 10, 'no, one high game is a single value'.

widgets.component: IQR and meaning, Q3 of six orders, long box means spread
widgets.root: Keys verified (16; Q3 = 66 with the stated halves rule; long box = spread of the middle half).

widgets.component: Range of a box plot; compare two box plots on median, IQR and range
widgets.root: The range variant and the L4 statements ('greater range, because its whisker reaches farther') need range, taught in 2-5.
widgets.replacement: Remove the range variant: replace 'What is the range?' with 'What is the third quartile (Q3)?' or 'What is the length of the box?' and, for the L4 comparison statements, keep only median and IQR/box-length claims (drop 'greater range ... because its whisker reaches farther').

widgets.component: Count of values between / at or below quartiles
Quartile error, two-team write-up, feature match, five-number table, box plot readings, whisker-length misconception, IQR
widgets.root: Rechecked 25/28/33/39.5/44/IQR 11.5, 8-value summary 3, 5, 8, 12, 15, Grill IQR 8 vs Salad 18, Kitchen A and B equal IQR 20, 80-loaf half = 40, Q1 = 34 − 14 = 20.

widgets.where: Challenge §4 item 2 (err), §5 item 5 (num with box figure)
widgets.component: Mina subtracts smallest from largest (range) / range of a menu from a box plot
widgets.root: Both items use the range (41 − 6 = 35; 52 − 4 = 48), taught in 2-5.
widgets.replacement: Item 4.2: keep the IQR-vs-length-of-whiskers slip but make the wrong move 'subtract Q1 from the median'. Item 5.5: ask 'What is the median? What is the length of the box?' from the same figure (16; 10).

widgets.where: Challenge §3 items 1-2 (act:chartbuild mode box, L3-L4), item 3 (sort)
widgets.component: Build the chart with typed IQR; sort descriptions to box / whiskers / median line
widgets.root: L3+ adds a typed IQR graded against Q3 − Q1 and traps entering the range; the sort covers the lesson's vocabulary parts.
